spans.s:
नैक नैक, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. न + एक), not
one, more than one, several, manifold, various, nu-
merous, many.
—नैक-चर, अस्, आ or ई, अम्, going
about in troops or flocks, gregarious, living in society,
not living alone.
—नैक-दुःख-दा, आस्, आस्, अम्,
causing many sorrows.
—नैक-दृश्, क्, m., N. of
one of the sons of Viśvā-mitra.
—नैक-पृष्ठ,
आस्, m. pl., N. of a people.
—नैक-भावाश्रय
(˚व-आश्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, ‘not abiding in one condition,’
changeable, fickle, unsteady.
—नैक-भेद, अस्, आ,
अम्, of many kinds, various, multiform, manifold.
—नैक-रूप, अस्, आ, अम्, multiform, of various
kinds, various.
—नैक-वर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, many
coloured, of various colours.
—नैक-शस्त्र-मय,
अस्, ई, अम्, consisting of a multitude of arrows or of
various missiles.
—नैकात्मन् (˚क-आत्˚), आ, आ, अ, of
manifold nature; (आ), m. an epithet of Śiva.

नैकधा, ind. in many ways, in various ways,
[]
manifoldly, in many parts, in many directions, on
various sides.

नैकशस्, ind. in great numbers, repeatedly, several
times, often.

नैकटिक नैकटिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. नि-कट),
near, contiguous, neighbouring, living in the neigh-
bourhood.

नैकट्य, अम्, n. nearness, proximity, neighbour-
hood, vicinage.

नैकती नैकती, f., N. of a village in the
North of India.

नैकषेय नैकषेय, अस्, m. a child of
Nikaṣā, a Rākṣasa, fiend, goblin; N. of a race of
Rākṣasas; (also read नैकसेय.)
